name: Tabbaot
title: Ancestor of a family of temple servants
summary: Tabbaot was the ancestor of a family of Nethinim (temple servants) who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem. His family is mentioned in the lists of those who returned with Zerubbabel to rebuild the temple and restore worship in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Listed among the families of temple servants in Ezra
keyEvents.description: Tabbaot's descendants are mentioned among the Nethinim (temple servants) who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem after the exile.

keyEvents.title: Listed among the families of temple servants in Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Tabbaot's family is again mentioned in Nehemiah's parallel list of those who returned from the exile, confirming their role as temple servants.

keyEvents.title: The Return from Babylon
keyEvents.description: Tabbaot's descendants were among the many families that followed Zerubbabel back to Judah to rebuild the temple and restore worship in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: The Role of Temple Servants in the Rebuilding
keyEvents.description: As Nethinim, the descendants of Tabbaoth had an important service role in the temple, where they assisted the Levites with practical tasks related to worship.
